Annual entry draft that handed LeBron, Duncan, and the next era to teams.

How NBA draft connects

  • Topic: NBA — The NBA draft is the league's annual entry auction.
  • Character: LeBron James — LeBron James was the 2003 draft prize that remade Cleveland, then the league.
  • Character: Tim Duncan — Tim Duncan's draft landing in San Antonio built two decades of contention.

The NBA draft is how franchises are remade: Duncan to San Antonio, LeBron to Cleveland, and lottery mythology that feeds the next Finals.
